name: branding-roobert-type-specimen-and-four-colour-palette-slide
title: Roobert Specimen and Four-Colour Palette
whatItIs: A pale grey slide titled Typography & Colors with a giant black 'Roobert' specimen partly covered by a frosted weight card, heading and text alphabets, a type scale card and four tall gradient swatches (charcoal, white, green, red) with hex codes and a solid bar at the base.
whatItMeans: A frosted card overlapping the giant name adds depth to a spec sheet, and glowing swatches make a simple palette feel rich.
techniques: Frosted weight card overlapping the specimen
Swatches as blurred glows with a solid bar
Type scale card with sizes in px
Very large specimen filling the width

vocabulary.definition: A translucent blurred card placed over content.
A colour sample shown as a soft glow above a solid bar.
A card listing text roles and their sizes.
